items.title: Rob Mounsey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 9, 2025
items.q: I met Norman Dello Joio and George Crumb and Robert [William] Schuman

ctx.x: I flew to New York City for the first time and there was a little — I was just in a daze but I met Norman Dello Joio and George Crumb and Robert [William] Schuman, you know a

lot of very famous contemporary serious composers, concert composers, who I barely appreciated and I was already interested in jazz music and in all kinds of popular music. But yeah, I had been writing this crazy orchestra music from age eleven or so at that point.
